column1: # experiment: E16 query-tile experiment: fused int8 attention against bf16 and the no-dequantise timing variant

column10: non-causal; inputs: the files of e16_attention.cu (e16_input_d<D>_s<S>_bh<BH>.bin of E16_INPUT_DIR
column11: generated on the host); time_ms_* = per call
column12: from `blocks` blocks of `calls_per_block` calls enqueued back to back between two CUDA events (the GPU time of the call; the block lasts about E16_BLOCK_MS)
column13: after a warm-up of at least E16_WARMUP_MS of GPU time; every call launches its own argument set (the operations of the call)
column14: rebuilt before the events; prep_us_per_call = host time (steady_clock) of building that set and releasing the one it replaces
column15: per call; position = place of the variant in the order of its configuration (the variants are rotated by configuration index + E16_ROTATE); TFLOP/s = 4 BH S^2 D / time_ms_median. Every variant is executeFlashAttentionMma with EXPLICIT tiles (variant name: bq = BLOCK_Q
column17: w = warps; raw_default is the library's own pick). int8_* = K and V int8 with one fp32 scale per token (quantised schedule). int8nodq_* = TIMING ONLY (timing_only = 1): THE OUTPUT IS WRONG (max_abs_err and mean_abs_err of those rows are meaningless) and the rows are never a result: the same schedule with a patched private copy of the library header whose dequantTile removes the int-to-float conversion
column18: the scale multiply and the float-to-bf16 rounding and keeps the copies
column21: the scale loads and the 16-byte store. The decision rule and the definitions of excess
column22: ratio and share are in the header comment of fkl-self/attention/e16_query_tile.cu
column23: fixed before the first run. kernel_facts = registers
